_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — acceptance business shape. Preserves the accepted-quote commitment shape 9.3 compares: the accepted price öre (acceptedPriceOre), the channel, an unchanged accepted price (equal to the recalculated total) AND an ADJUSTED accepted price (with an adjustment reason and a non-zero delta). ZERO PII (öre + channel + reason text only; no name/email/personnummer). Every öre integer < 10 digits (orgnr-scan safe). An acceptance-evidence reference is a file-link REFERENCE (see the files fixture), NEVER a raw file blob (R-901/AC1). Cases are origin:new-expected.

cases.note: The customer accepts at the quoted total unchanged — acceptedPriceOre equals recalculatedTotalOre, so the adjustment delta is 0 and no adjustment reason is required. Preserves the unchanged-acceptance shape.

The customer accepts at an ADJUSTED (negotiated-down) price — acceptedPriceOre is below the recalculated total, carrying an adjustment reason and a non-zero delta. Preserves the adjusted-acceptance shape (the delta feeds the Epic-7 correction boundary).
